{{Quote|Well get this! Now we have been in LOCKDOWN now for five hole Hours and I have not seen a Single Guard for that hole time. Mybe they gave up! Come to think of it we shud have gone to the Mess by now. I am sure Hungry. And plus also my cellmate is (illegible) in his bunk. I think he is Sick or something.|Nox Xakarta in a message to an associate|<ref name="Messages" />}}
An '''individual''' shared a cell aboard the [[Imperial prison barge]] [[Purge (prison barge)|''Purge'']] with fellow [[Prisoner/Legends|inmate]] [[Nox Xakarta]] while being transferred to a [[Gradient Seven corrections facility|corrections facility]] on a [[Moon/Legends|moon]]<ref name="Messages" /> known by its [[Imperial Military/Legends|military]] designation [[Gradient Seven]]<ref name="Email">{{EmailCite|email=File:EAOC discussion.jpg|creator=Jason Fry|date=2015-06-30}}</ref> in [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]].<ref name="Date" /> During the journey, the ''Purge''{{'s}} inmates and crew were exposed to [[Imperial bioweapons Project I71A]], leading the majority of the individuals present to become sick, including Xakarta's cellmate. While the ''Purge'' was in lockdown, the individual rested in his bunk and Xakarta wrote a message to an [[Nox Xakarta's "brother"|associate]], which included a mention of the cellmate and his situation.<ref name="Messages" />

The [[Disease/Legends|virus]] eventually [[Death/Legends|killed]] and [[Zombie/Legends|reanimated]] most of the inmates and crew,<ref name="Novel">''[[Death Troopers]]''</ref> including Xakarta and the cellmate.<ref name="Date" /> Some [[Time/Legends|time]] later, the ''Purge'' was discovered in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. Xakarta's message mentioning the cellmate was recovered from the barge and published in the interest of [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Scholar/Legends|scholarship]].<ref name="Messages" />

==Behind the scenes==
Xakarta's cellmate was mentioned in a message<ref name="Messages" /> written by [[Joe Schreiber]]<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> and posted to swactionnews.com on [[September 10]], [[2009]].<ref name="Messages" /> The message was among [[Death Troopers: Recovered Messages from Purge|several]] that were distributed across various official and unofficial ''[[Star Wars]]'' websites as promotion for Schreiber's novel ''[[Death Troopers]]''<ref name="TERC" /> released on [[October 13]] of that same year.<ref name="Board">{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=222689&start=8175#17541629|thread=Books, Comics, & Television VIPs|author=[[Sue Rostoni]]|date=2009-02-12|time=12:58 PM|quote=Del Rey has decided to publish DEATHTROOPERS as a hardcover instead of a paperback, and it's now coming out October 13th.}}</ref>
